Moody’s MadHatter Ball

Sun, May 1, 2022 · 11:00 AM – 4:30 PM · The APT Event Space

When
Sun, May 1, 2022 · 11:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Where
The APT Event Space
511 Central Avenue Northeast #5, Minneapolis, Minnesota
Cost
$75.00

Go down the rabbit hole for a Mad Hatter Tea Party!

Appetite at the APT transforms itself into a lush vibrant garden party, Chef Jametta Rasberry takes a maddening knife to brunch and high tea menus while Fashion Designer / Influencer Richard Moody’s designs and models lead you further down the rabbit hole. Lest we forget, no party is complete without a cup or two of spilt tea! You’ll most definitely want to wear a tea hat, Sunday hat, walking hat, opera hat, bridal hat, but most definitely not a baseball hat.
